title: The Heavens Declare His Glory
description: The Heavens Declare His Glory in Tonic Solfa to GREENLAND, doh is Eb: the solfa with the words, staff notation, 3 verses and a piano.
about: Josiah Conder wrote these words. They were printed in Hymns for Christian Devotion, compiled by John G. Adams and Edwin H. Chapin (Boston, 1846), as hymn 181 of its twenty-second edition (1853), “"Day unto day uttereth speech."”.

The book printed the words without tunes, marked Sevens and Sixes Double (7.6.7.6.7.6.7.6), to be sung to any tune of that metre. This page sets them to GREENLAND; any other Sevens and Sixes Double tune fits them as well.
underlay: The heavens de-clare his glo-ry, Their Mak-er's skill the skies: Each day re-peats the sto-ry, And night to night re-plies. Their si-lent pro-cla-ma-tion Through-out the earth is heard; The re-cord of cre-a-tion, The page of na-ture's word.

lines: The sun sets forth; right glad,
Than all the pomp of day:

licence: Public domain: Josiah Conder died in 1855.
credits: Words by Josiah Conder (1789–1855), public domain, as printed in Hymns for Christian Devotion (1853); set to GREENLAND by NoteFusion, as words-only hymn books were sung.
